name: sgs/option-picker
title: SGS Option Picker
description: Exclusive single-select pill chooser for pack sizes, flavours, colours, plan tiers, or any option set. Emits a custom DOM event on selection — fully decoupled from any parent block.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: The image-swatch (style.css .sgs-option-picker__swatch--image) is a fixed 2rem square crop of a WooCommerce attribute term's `_sgs_swatch_image_id` image — no per-instance media picker, but the crop MODE (cover|contain) is a legitimate client choice (e.g. a white-background product photo may want 'contain'). Wired via the shared object-fit atom, prefix 'swatch'.

root.label: Picker (fieldset)
root._note: Content-KIND, no wrapper — the <fieldset> IS the block root (no SGS_Container_Wrapper call). Border radius stays WP-native; width/style/colour are SGS custom object/string attrs (borderWidth/borderStyle/borderColour) — mapped explicitly since no prefix covers bare root attrs. Root has no independent typography (fontSize/weight/etc belong to legend/pill) — those text-cluster members are honest gaps.

label.label: Group label (legend)
label._note: labelFontSize/labelColour/labelFontWeight/labelFontStyle/labelMarginBottom resolve via the default {prefix}{suffix} convention (labelMarginBottom -> css:margin-bottom, Spec 35 vocabulary; legend `margin-bottom:...`). line-height/letter-spacing/text-transform/text-decoration/text-align/font-family have no labelX equivalent — honest gaps. labelColourGradient is the text-colour gradient sibling to labelColour (background-clip:text mechanism, same recipe as sgs/quote's attributionColour/attributionColourGradient) — needs an explicit attrMap entry since the default prefix convention only covers css:color, not the gradient sibling.

pill.label: Option pill
pill._note: FR-35-5 — 'selected' (NOT :hover/:active) is the correct state name for the pillSelected* family: style.css:200/246/277 key the selected look off `input[type=radio]:checked ~ .pill`, which is the [aria-current]/is-active family the states vocabulary calls 'selected'. The `:hover` visual is backed by real attributes `pillBgColourHover`/`pillTextColourHover`, declared as this element's 'hover' state below, mirroring sgs/nav-bar-menu's item-bg/item-text normal+hover row pattern. css:background-color needs explicit attrMap (pillBgColour doesn't match the default Background/Bg/BackgroundColour suffixes); css:border-color (pillBorderColour) and css:border-radius (pillBorderRadius) and css:padding (pillPadding) and css:font-size (pillFontSize) all resolve via the default convention. css:font-weight is an honest gap — no pillFontWeight attr exists. pillBgColour/pillBgColourHover carry pillBgColourGradient/pillBgColourHoverGradient siblings via `sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls()` (helpers-tokens.php) — the same shape used on brand-strip/post-grid/social-icons/form/gallery/before-after. style.css declares `background-image:var(--sgs-op-bg[-hover]-gradient,none)` next to each existing `background-color:var(...)` line, so the two properties coexist unconditionally and the gradient only paints when the resolved custom property is set; no conditional property-switching needed. pillTextColourGradient uses the text builder (`sgs_resolve_text_colour_or_gradient()`/`sgs_text_colour_decl()`/`sgs_text_colour_gradient_fallback_rule()`), same recipe as labelColourGradient; css:color-gradient needs the explicit attrMap entry above since the default prefix convention only covers css:color, not the gradient sibling. tileGap (Wave B) needs an explicit css:gap attrMap entry — the default {prefix}{suffix} convention would look for pillGap, not tileGap; tile-style-only (outlined/filled/ghost ignore it), CSS-length string, sgs_css_length_value()-sanitised, emitted as --sgs-option-picker-tile-gap on the root (render.php §6), consumed by style.css's .sgs-option-picker--tile .sgs-option-picker__options gap rule.

sub-label.label: Option sub-label
sub-label._note: Wave B — the second caption line under an option's label (e.g. a frame size's eye/bridge/temple measurement), sourced from subLabelMetaKey (a WooCommerce term-meta key selector, not a colour/size value — its control lives in the block's Settings panel, not Styles, per THE PLACEMENT RULE C3). Paints via the pill's own resolved text colour at reduced opacity by design (style.css .sgs-option-picker__sub-label), so there is no dedicated sub-label colour/size attribute and this element carries no attrMap. Declared here for manifest completeness / orphan-scan visibility (Spec 35 Part O) — mirrors sgs/button's icon element, which also declares clusters: [] for the same reason.

labelColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the label legend's text via background-clip:text (text builder). Non-empty wins over labelColour.

labelColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of labelColourHover. Non-empty wins over labelColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

subLabelMetaKey.description: Optional term-meta key (on the picker's resolved WooCommerce attribute taxonomy term) shown as a second caption line under each option's label, e.g. a frame size's eye/bridge/temple measurement. '' (default) = off, no second line, byte-identical to the current markup.

showTermDetails.description: WC-bound pickers only (typeKey resolves to a pa_* taxonomy): show each term's badge (a small pill, `_sgs_term_badge`) and short description (a line under the label, `_sgs_term_description`) when the term has them set (Spec 43 FR-43-25). Off = neither renders, byte-identical to the current markup.

pillStyle.description: 'tile' is an image-forward vertical card (optional image/colour block above a caption) for option sets like a frame size or lens tile, instead of the horizontal pill row.

tileGap.description: Gap between tiles, tile pill style only (CSS length, e.g. "12px"). Empty = the framework default (8px).

pillBgColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting pill background via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over pillBgColour.

pillTextColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting pill text via background-clip:text (text builder). Non-empty wins over pillTextColour.

pillBgColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover pill background via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over pillBgColourHover.

pillBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting pill border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over pillBorderColour.

pillSelectedBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the selected pill border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over pillSelectedBorderColour.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the root fieldset border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour.
